rules.statement: Open WebUI binds only to `127.0.0.1` on the WSL host by default.
rules.title: Open WebUI binds to localhost
rules.why: Keeps the browser service off LAN-facing interfaces unless an operator deliberately adds stronger controls.

rules.statement: Open WebUI receives no host workspace.
rules.title: Open WebUI receives no host workspace
rules.why: Prevents the service from gaining direct access to host project files.

rules.statement: Open WebUI receives no Docker socket.
rules.title: Open WebUI receives no Docker socket
rules.why: Prevents the web application from controlling the Docker daemon.

rules.title: Open WebUI keeps authentication enabled
rules.why: Maintains an authenticated boundary even while the service is localhost-only.

rules.statement: Use a strong password for the Open WebUI administrator account.
rules.title: Use a strong Open WebUI administrator password
rules.why: The first local account has administrator authority over the service.

rules.statement: Do not publish the Open WebUI localhost port through a proxy or LAN interface without appropriate TLS, authentication and network controls.
rules.title: Do not expose Open WebUI without added controls
rules.why: Localhost binding is the default safety boundary; broader exposure requires compensating controls.
